parameters.name: input_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing the input dF/F traces.
parameters.help_text: Directory containing the input dF/F traces.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where output files will be saved.
parameters.help_text: Directory where output files will be saved.

parameters.name: frame_rate
parameters.description: Frame rate in Hz, used when the metadata provides none.
parameters.help_text: Frame rate in Hz, used when the metadata provides none.

parameters.name: estimate_parameters
parameters.description: Estimate the model parameters, including lam, from the noise constraint; otherwise use the values provided.
parameters.help_text: Estimate the model parameters, including lam, from the noise constraint; otherwise use the values provided.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Exponential (1/e) decay time in seconds. Estimated from the data when unset; required when estimate_parameters is False.
parameters.help_text: Exponential (1/e) decay time in seconds. Estimated from the data when unset; required when estimate_parameters is False.

parameters.name: tau_rise
parameters.description: Exponential (1/e) rise time in seconds. 0 selects an AR1 model, any other value AR2.
parameters.help_text: Exponential (1/e) rise time in seconds. 0 selects an AR1 model, any other value AR2.

parameters.name: optimize_tau
parameters.description: Number of large, isolated events used to refine tau; 0 disables the refinement.
parameters.help_text: Number of large, isolated events used to refine tau; 0 disables the refinement.

parameters.name: baseline
parameters.description: Fluorescence baseline. When unset it is optimized if estimate_parameters is True, else 0.
parameters.help_text: Fluorescence baseline. When unset it is optimized if estimate_parameters is True, else 0.

parameters.name: b_nonneg
parameters.description: Enforce a strictly non-negative baseline if True.
parameters.help_text: Enforce a strictly non-negative baseline if True.

parameters.name: sn
parameters.description: Noise standard deviation. Estimated from the power spectral density when unset.
parameters.help_text: Noise standard deviation. Estimated from the power spectral density when unset.

parameters.name: lam
parameters.description: Sparsity penalty weight. When unset it is estimated from the noise constraint if estimate_parameters is True, else 0.
parameters.help_text: Sparsity penalty weight. When unset it is estimated from the noise constraint if estimate_parameters is True, else 0.

parameters.name: s_min
parameters.description: Minimal non-zero activity per bin (minimal spike size).
parameters.help_text: Minimal non-zero activity per bin (minimal spike size).

parameters.name: no_qc
parameters.description: Skip generation of the per-ROI QC plots.
parameters.help_text: Skip generation of the per-ROI QC plots.
